title: Word Search
statement: Return true when `word` can be formed by adjacent letters on the board. Adjacent means 4-directional. A cell may be used once per path.
hints: DFS from every cell that matches the first letter.
Mark the current cell as used before exploring neighbors, and unmark it afterward.
Prune when the remaining board cannot contain the next character. The basic version just checks the character.

approaches.name: DFS backtracking
approaches.explanation: L is the word length. The board is small.

editorial: The search state is the cell and the index in the word. A cell matches when it is in bounds, unused, and equal to word[index]. Mark it, try four neighbors at index + 1, and unmark it so another path can use it. Reaching the end of the word returns true.

examples.explanation: The word snakes through the board.
